content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

In essence, this architecture provides a foundation for creators to sell digital products directly to their audience without relying on intermediary platforms. The significance lies in the independence it grants. Instead of paying high fees, such as Gumroad's 10% on every sale, you can utilize NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%. This difference means at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you're retaining an extra $921. This financial freedom allows creators to reinvest in their craft or expand their offerings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The core of this architecture revolves around free and accessible tools that work in synergy. Hosting your digital products can be done through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. For backend processing, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can automate order fulfillment. With a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets, and delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, everything is streamlined. Finally, integrating NOWPayments facilitates automatic cryptocurrency payment processing, ensuring you receive your funds without delays or complications.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is designed specifically for digital creators looking to sell ebooks, courses, templates, and more without the constraints of traditional payment platforms. It caters to individuals in regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or heavily restricted. By adopting this approach, creators can maintain control over their sales, significantly reduce transaction costs, and ensure that the entire process is seamless and user-friendly for their customers.
Retain more revenue by avoiding high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The architecture consists of multiple components that each play a critical role in the overall functionality. Starting with a hosting platform like GitHub Pages, it allows for free hosting of your digital content. Coupling this with backend systems like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script automates processes like order confirmation and delivery. NOWPayments handles the cryptocurrency transactions, while storage solutions like Supabase ensure all order data is securely maintained. Together, these elements create a robust ecosystem for digital sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first select your hosting provider, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate order processing. Store your product information in Supabase or Google Sheets, and prepare your files for delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions. This streamlined approach allows you to launch your digital product storefront quickly and effectively.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Leverage cryptocurrency to streamline your payment process.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell an ebook without using PayPal or Stripe?
Utilize a combination of free hosting services and automated backend solutions to create your digital store. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing to handle transactions efficiently.
What are the benefits of selling digital downloads without platform fees?
By avoiding platform fees, you keep more revenue from each sale. This allows for greater flexibility in pricing and profitability, enabling you to invest more in your business.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, by setting up your own digital storefront using free tools and integrating cryptocurrency payments, you can sell templates and fonts independently of traditional platforms.
What payment options are available for selling digital products?
Utilize NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring you have access to a wide range of payment options without the need for traditional payment processors.
How do I automate product delivery?
You can automate product delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order confirmations and send download links automatically after payment verification.
Maintain full ownership of your digital storefront and data.
